title: 第七章 单挑吞食第八章 宴请兽人肉
slug: 西幻从骑士六艺肝出无限神职
lines: 李奥抓起一把草料，放在鼻子前闻了闻，好像没什么问题。
刚刚他听这些马儿说，这草料里有一股令他们恐惧的味道。
不过他闻不出来。
不管那么多，李奥走进马厩，将原本马槽里的草料清理干净。
弄了一捆新的草料，用闸刀切断，然后混合了细料，重新倒进马槽。
李奥感觉自己虽然练了一天的剑，但是搬运草料明显比昨天轻松了不少，应该是力量属性增加了0.1的效果。
做完这些，李奥又对马匹进行了安抚。
这些马儿才看在李奥的面子上开始进食。
李奥看着面板，做完这一套工序，御马技能的经验增长了2点。
“哼，果然是乡下小领主的儿子，还真是会养马。”艾迪插着手，在边上冷嘲热讽。
“滚滚滚，起开！”亚瑟对准了艾迪的屁股便是一脚。
今天一天，就听这艾迪在那抱怨，亚瑟早就烦了，“你父亲也不过是边境的一个男爵，天天乡下乡下，听得我耳朵都起茧了。”
亚瑟从艾迪面前走过，到了李奥面前。
李奥看着亚瑟那一脚，蛮横，霸道！
果然是伯爵之子才有的气势。
不过此时见亚瑟靠近，李奥的手已经不自觉的握住了腰间木剑。
练了一天，他的身体已经有了下意识的防御反应。
可此时的亚瑟却是嬉笑着，他搭着李奥的肩膀，“兄弟，别激动，正式介绍一下，亚瑟，来自银松领。昨天多亏了你出手相救。”
李奥确认对方没有恶意，松开了手里的木剑。
“来来来，快过来帮忙。”亚瑟看李奥辛苦照顾马匹，招呼着的霍格。
然后他继续说道，“没想到你今天还会回来帮我，既然你这么仗义，那我亚瑟也绝不是恩将仇报之辈。我们抓紧干完活，去灰石城里好好放松放松。”
“放松？”李奥有些鄙夷的看着亚瑟，越看这个傻大个越像是那种声色犬马、放浪形骸的二代，“你说的是……妓院？”
亚瑟一把捂住李奥的嘴，“别乱说！我可从来没去过那种地方，这话传到我父亲耳朵里，他非打断我的腿。”
一旁的霍格此时解释道，“亚瑟的意思是一起去教会餐厅吃一顿，这城堡里的吃的东西有限，而且还不能饮酒。”
“不了。”李奥拒绝了对方的邀请，继续埋头干着手里的活。
他的计划是在这肝完御马的熟练度，然后便回去好好休息，明天还要继续练剑呢。
至于晚饭，女仆娜塔莉应该已经留好了今天的饭食。
城镇虽然就在城堡外，但是来回一趟也会浪费不少时间。
李奥对于这种没有价值的社交活动并没有太大兴趣。
“诶~正好你开始练剑了，我们可以好好交流交流剑术，我养马不行，可练剑却是一把好手。”亚瑟眼神之中透着自信。
“而且我这里还有强身健体的秘方，要不要试试。”
content_en:
Leo grabbed a handful of grass, put it in front of his nose and smelled it. There seemed to be nothing wrong with it.
He just heard these horses say that there was a smell in the fodder that frightened them.
But he couldn't smell it.
No matter so much, Leo walked into the stable and cleaned up the fodder in the manger.
A new bundle of hay was obtained, cut with a guillotine, then mixed with fine material and poured back into the manger.
Leo felt that although he had been practicing swordplay for a day, carrying the fodder was obviously much easier than yesterday. It should be due to the increase in strength attribute by 0.1.
After doing this, Leo comforted the horse again.
These horses just started eating for Leo's sake.
Leo looked at the panel. After completing this set of procedures, his horse riding skill experience increased by 2 points.
"Hmph, he is indeed the son of a small country lord, and he really knows how to raise horses." Eddie put his hands in and sneered from the side.
"Go, go, get up!" Arthur aimed at Eddie's butt and kicked him.
Today, just listening to Eddie complaining, Arthur has long been annoyed, "Your father is just a baron on the border. He goes to the countryside every day. My ears are getting calloused."
Arthur walked past Eddie and came to Leo.
Leo looked at Arthur's kick, it was arrogant and domineering!
Sure enough, it was the son of an earl who had the aura.
But seeing Arthur approaching at this time, Leo's hand had unconsciously grasped the wooden sword at his waist.
After practicing for a day, his body already had a subconscious defensive reaction.
But at this time, Arthur was laughing playfully. He put his arm around Leo's shoulder and said, "Brother, don't get excited. Let me introduce you formally. Arthur is from Silver Pine Territory. Thanks to your rescue yesterday."
Leo confirmed that the other party had no ill intentions and released the wooden sword in his hand.
"Come on, come on, come and help." Arthur greeted Hogg as he saw Leo working hard to take care of the horses.
Then he continued, "I didn't expect you to come back to help me today. Since you are so generous, then I, Arthur, am definitely not someone who repays kindness with hatred. Let's finish our work quickly and go to Greystone City to relax and relax."
"Relax?" Leo looked at Arthur with some disdain. The more he looked at this stupid man, the more he looked like the second generation of sensual and bohemian people. "Are you talking about...a brothel?"
Arthur covered Leo's mouth, "Don't talk nonsense! I have never been to that kind of place. When these words reached my father's ears, he had to break my legs."
Hogg on the side explained at this time, "Arthur means to go to the church restaurant for a meal together. The food in this castle is limited, and drinking is not allowed."
"No." Leo rejected the other party's invitation and continued to work hard.
His plan is to perfect his proficiency in horse riding here, and then go back to have a good rest. He will continue to practice swordsmanship tomorrow.
As for dinner, the maid Natalie should have saved today's meals.
Although the town is just outside the castle, a round trip would waste a lot of time.
Leo was not very interested in such worthless social activities.
"Hey~ It just so happens that you have started practicing swordsmanship. We can have a good exchange of swordsmanship. I am not good at raising horses, but I am a good swordsman." Arthur's eyes showed confidence.
"And I also have a secret recipe for keeping fit. Do you want to try it?"
